info.title: CamillaGUI
info.description: The API between the CamillaGUI backend and its frontend. It is internal to the GUI and changes with it, so it has no version of its own.

get.summary:
The device types CamillaDSP supports, null until it has been reached. They
cannot change while it runs, so this comes from the cache.

Check the configs the built-in controller can follow with: each file the
Specific template matches, and the entry config Adapt starts from. Loads
every file, so it is run on demand rather than polled. Files in config_dir
are given as file names.

The settings of CamillaDSP's built-in controller, the `controller`
section of its statefile, null when there is none. A Specific template in
config_dir is given as a file name.

get.summary:
The processing state, and the VU levels and the spectrum when asked for,
as one stream of server-sent events, so that a GUI tab holds one of the
browser's few connections to the backend.
get.description:
It starts with a `state` event with the current state, then has one for
each change, and ends when CamillaDSP goes away. The `levels` and
`spectrum` events come as CamillaDSP sends them, and a spectrum refused
while processing is stopped starts once it runs. A `heartbeat` event
comes every two seconds. The parameters come in the query string, since an
EventSource can only GET, and changing them means opening a new stream.
The data of each event is in `EventPayloads`, by event name.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description:
Send the VU levels, as `levels` events. Smoothing and rate come from
the settings.

parameters.name: side
parameters.description:
The side to send the spectrum of, as `spectrum` events. No spectrum
without it.

schema.description:
Side selector for spectrum analysis commands.

Serialised as a lowercase string: `"playback"` or `"capture"`.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: The channel of the spectrum, all channels averaged without it.

parameters.name: min_freq
parameters.description: The lower edge of the spectrum in Hz, needed with a `side`.

parameters.name: max_freq
parameters.description: The upper edge of the spectrum in Hz, needed with a `side`.

parameters.name: n_bins
parameters.description: The number of spectrum bins, needed with a `side`.

parameters.name: max_rate
parameters.description: The most spectra a second, as fast as CamillaDSP makes them without it.

400.description: A spectrum is missing a parameter

get.summary:
The fingerprints of the folders, for noticing changes made behind the GUI's
back. Polling these is cheap, since only the file names, sizes and times
are read, so a folder is listed again only when it changed.
get.description:
A poll rather than an event stream, since a browser has only six
connections to the backend for all its tabs, and an open stream holds one.

get.summary: The files in a folder, sorted by name.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description:
Whether to find out what each file contains, which means reading
them. Left out, the details are included. With `false`, only the
name, size and time of each file are listed.

Store files in a folder. Uploaded configs have their coefficient and audio

work here.

post.summary: Some of the files in a folder, as a zip file to save.
post.description:
The body is a form, as the browser posts it, so that the browser saves
the zip as it arrives. The zip is made as it is sent. The files are
checked first, and an error after the zip started cuts it short.

Check a config without applying it, with the file paths as the GUI has

The body is meant to be a config, but any JSON is taken, since a config
that does not parse is reported as an issue like any other. This is the
one request body the spec does not take from the handler.

config_file_name.description:
The file name of the active config, null when there is none, or it is
not in config_dir.

AdaptCheck.description:
The entry config that the Adapt provider starts from, and what is wrong with it, if
anything. The format is the one the config is written for, after the command line
overrides. Adapt changes the rate and the sample format, but not the channel count.

file.description: Path of the entry config file, `null` for a config that was sent over the websocket.

samplerate.description: Capture sample rate, `null` when no config is loaded.

samplerates.description:
The rates that run natively, when `samplerate` is a list, with the preferred one first.
Other rates are resampled to the first one. `null` for a single `samplerate`, and then
every rate runs natively.

channels.description: Capture channels, `null` when no config is loaded.

format.description: Capture sample format, `null` when it is automatic or no config is loaded.

problem.description:
What is wrong with the config, `null` if it is usable. Also lists the settings that
are only right at the config's own rate, when Adapt would change its samplerate.

AsyncPolyInterpolation.description: Polynomial interpolation order for the async polynomial resampler.

AsyncSincInterpolation.description: Sinc interpolation quality for the async sinc resampler.

AsyncSincParameters.description: Parameters for the async sinc resampler: either a named profile or free parameters.

AsyncSincProfile.description: Preset quality profile for the async sinc resampler.

AsyncSincWindow.description: Window function used by the async sinc resampler.

AudioDeviceDescriptor.description: Full capability descriptor for a named audio device.

capability_sets.description: Capability sets, one per access mode supported by the backend.

BiquadComboParameters.description: Multi-section biquad combination type (crossover, EQ, tilt, …).

BiquadParameters.description: Biquad filter type and its frequency/gain/Q parameters.

CapabilityMode.description:
The access mode a [`DeviceCapabilitySet`] was probed under.

- `Unified`: the device uses a unified capability model (ALSA, CoreAudio, ASIO).
- `Shared`: WASAPI shared-mode capabilities, derived from the mix format.
- `Exclusive`: WASAPI exclusive-mode capabilities, probed independently.

oneOf.description: Test-only paced capture device, see `src/dummy_backend`.

control_port.description: Port of the test control socket, see `src/dummy_backend/control.rs`.

source_port.description: Port of the simulated source, see `src/dummy_backend/source.rs`.

ChannelCapability.description: The sample rates (and their formats) supported by a device at a specific channel count.

samplerates.description: Supported sample rates for this channel count.

playback.description:
Labels for playback channels. `null` if no labels are configured. Each entry is a label
string, or `null` if that specific channel has no label.

capture.description: Labels for capture channels. Same structure as `playback`.

CoeffDefaults.description:
Sensible parameters for a Conv filter reading a coefficient file, from the
file's extension. Empty when the extension says nothing.

CoeffsHeader.description: The JSON header of a coefficient frame, see `frame_coefficients`.

options.description: The variants of the file for other samplerates and channel counts.

parameters.description:
The parameters of a Raw or Wav Conv filter, with the file path as the
GUI has it.

samplerate.description: For the `$samplerate$` token in the file name.

channels.description: For the `$channels$` token in the file name.

CompressorParameters.description: Parameters for the dynamic range compressor processor.

config.description: With the file paths as the GUI has them, relative to the configured folders.

ConfigElement.description: A value in the config that a shortcut controls.

path.description: The keys leading to the value.

reverse.description: Move this one the opposite way of the control.

ConfigFragment.description:
Part of a config, as an import gives it: any of the sections, with any of
the device settings.

ConfigProvider.description:
The provider that supplied a config of the files source.

- `Single`: the entry config file as is.
- `Adapt`: the entry config file adapted to the source format.
- `Specific`: the per-format file the template gives.

ConfigSource.description: Where the config the GUI starts with came from.

Configuration.description: A complete CamillaDSP configuration: devices, filters, mixers, processors, and the pipeline.

ControllerFileChecks.description: Value of the `CheckControllerFiles` reply, one section per follow provider.

specific.description:
Each file the Specific template matches, with the format read from its name and the
problem found, if any. `null` when Specific is off.

oneOf.description: The entry config Adapt starts from. `null` when Adapt is off.
Follow the capture source format, absent to disable following.

The whole `controller` section, null to remove it. A Specific
template is a file name in config_dir, or an absolute path when
absolute paths are allowed.

ControllerSource.description:
Where the config the controller runs comes from.

- `Files`: the controller loads it from the entry config file, through a provider.
- `Websocket`: it was sent over the websocket, and runs exactly as sent.

ControllerStatusReport.description: The state of the built-in controller, returned by the `GetControllerStatus` command.

source.description: Where the config comes from. It stays until the next switch, also while nothing runs.

oneOf.description:
The provider of the running config. `null` for the websocket source, and while
nothing runs.

config_file.description:
The file that runs: the entry config file for `Single` and `Adapt`, the per-format
file for `Specific`. `null` when `provider` is.

entry_config_file.description:
The entry config file, the one `GetConfigFilePath` gives, and the one `Reload`
loads.

recovering.description: Waiting to retry after a device error.

attempts.description: Retries since the last session that ran long enough.

next_retry_s.description: Seconds until the next retry, while waiting for one.

oneOf.description: The source format no config was found for, while waiting for the source to change.

following.description: Whether following is on, enabled and in wait mode. `false` for the websocket source.

error_recovery.description: Whether error recovery is on, enabled and in wait mode.

ConvFileType.description: The Conv filter subtypes that read a file.

ConvParameters.description: Source of convolution coefficients for the FFT convolution filter.

ConvParametersRaw.description: Coefficients loaded from a raw binary or text file.

ConvParametersWav.description: Coefficients loaded from a specific channel of a WAV file.

DelayUnit.description: Unit for a time or distance value used by delays (Delay filter, RACE processor).

DeviceCapabilitySet.description: A set of device capabilities associated with a single access mode (e.g. exclusive vs. shared).

mode.description: The access mode these capabilities were probed under.

DeviceTypeLists.description: The device types a CamillaDSP build supports.

Devices.description: Top-level device and pipeline timing configuration.

samplerate.description: Output sample rate in Hz, or a list of the rates Adapt runs natively.

chunksize.description: Number of frames per processing chunk.

DevicesFragment.description:
Any of the device settings, since an import may have only some of them.
The fields of camilladsp-schema's `Devices`, every one optional and left
out when the import does not have it.

DiffEqParameters.description: Parameters for the difference-equation (IIR) filter: `a` (feedback) and `b` (feedforward) coefficients.

Direction.description: Which side of CamillaDSP a device is on.

DitherParameters.description: Dithering algorithm and bit depth for the dither filter.

text.description: The text of the Equalizer APO config.

channels.description: The number of channels, which decides what the channel names map to.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

message.description: What went wrong, to show to the user.

result.description:
When CamillaDSP refused a command, the name of its error, for example
`ProcessingNotRunningError`.

EventPayloads.description:
The data of each event the stream sends, by event name. The values are
passed on as CamillaDSP sent them, unparsed, so these are the types
CamillaDSP's protocol says they are. Nothing of this type is ever made,
it only describes the stream in the spec.

state.description:
A `state` event: the processing state, first the current one, then one
for each change.

levels.description: A `levels` event, one for each update from CamillaDSP.

spectrum.description: A `spectrum` event, one for each update from CamillaDSP.

heartbeat.description: A `heartbeat` event, an empty object every two seconds.

Fader.description: Volume and mute state for one fader, as returned by [`WsCommand::GetFaders`].

FileCheck.description: One file the Specific template matches, and what is wrong with it, if anything.

samplerate.description: Sample rate read from the file name, if the template has the token.

channels.description: Channels read from the file name, if the template has the token.

format.description: Sample format read from the file name, if the template has the token.

problem.description: What is wrong with the file, `null` if it is usable.

FileInfo.description:
A file in a listing. What is known about it beyond its name, size and time
depends on the folder: configs have their title, version and validity, wav
files their format, and coefficient files their format and length, for wav
and text files. What is not known is left out.

last_modified.description: The time of the last change, in seconds since the epoch.

version.description: For a config, the CamillaDSP version it is for.

outdated.description:
For a config, whether it is for an older CamillaDSP, and is migrated
when loaded.

valid.description:
For a config, whether it has no errors. For a wav file, and a wav or
text coefficient file, whether CamillaDSP can read it.

loadable.description:
For a config, whether the GUI can load it, migrating it first if it is
for an older version. It may still have errors to fix in the GUI.

errors.description:
For a config, its errors and warnings. For a text coefficient file,
why CamillaDSP cannot read it.

samplerate.description: For a wav file, in Hz.

sampleformat.description:
For a wav file, the CamillaDSP name of its sample format. For a text
coefficient file, `TEXT`.

duration.description: For a wav file, in seconds.

length.description: For a coefficient file, the number of values per channel.

FileKind.description: One of the folders the GUI keeps files in.

FileSampleFormat.description: Sample format used for coefficient files; extends [`BinarySampleFormat`] with a plain-text variant.

Filter.description: Filter type selector; each variant carries its own parameter struct.

FilterOption.description:
A variant of a coefficient file that exists, with the samplerate and
channels its name gives for the `$samplerate$` and `$channels$` tokens.

FolderFingerprints.description:
A fingerprint of each folder, as an opaque string that changes whenever a
file in the folder is added, removed, renamed or rewritten.

audiofile.description: Left out when no audiofiles_dir is set.

FollowCapture.description: Settings for following the capture source format.

specific.description: Template for the Specific provider, absent to disable it.

FollowChoice.description: How the controller picks the file to run.

adapt.description: Adapt the file to the source format.

specific.description:
The Specific template, a file name in config_dir, or null for no
Specific. With adapt as well, a format without its own file adapts the
config file.

GainParameters.description: Parameters for the static gain filter.

GainScale.description: Whether a gain value is interpreted as a linear factor or in decibels.

GeneralNotchParams.description: Parameters for the general (asymmetric pole/zero) notch biquad.

GraphicEqualizerParameters.description: Parameters for the graphic equalizer biquad combo filter.

coeff_dir.description:
coeff_dir, relative to config_dir and ending with a separator, from
`camillagui.yml` like the rest below.

can_update_active_config.description: Whether the backend can store which config file is the active one.

GuiConfig.description:
The GUI settings: `gui-config.yml`, and the few settings from
`camillagui.yml` that the frontend needs.

GuiConfigFile.description:
`gui-config.yml`. What it leaves out gets the default, and keys it does
not know are ignored.

page_title.description: The title of the browser tab.

volume_range.description: The range of the volume sliders, in dB.

volume_max.description: The top of the volume sliders, in dB.

spectrum_max_rate.description: The most spectrum updates per second.

custom_shortcuts.description: `custom_shortcuts:` with nothing after it is null, and means none.

text.description: The text of the file to import from.

LookaheadLimiterProcessorParameters.description: Parameters for the multichannel lookahead limiter processor.

LoudnessFader.description: Which fader drives the loudness filter's compensation level.

LoudnessParameters.description: Parameters for the loudness (Fletcher-Munson) compensation filter.

Mixer.description: Configuration for a named mixer: channel counts, routing rules, and optional labels.

MixerChannels.description: Input and output channel counts for a mixer.

MixerMapping.description: Routing rule: which sources feed a given destination channel in a mixer.

MixerSource.description: One input source contributing to a mixer output channel.

NoiseGateParameters.description: Parameters for the noise gate processor.

NotchWidth.description: Notch / allpass / bandpass width specified either as a Q factor or a bandwidth in octaves.

PathElement.description:
One step on the way to the value an issue is about: a map key or a list index.

Serialized untagged, so a path comes out as a plain list such as
`["pipeline", 2, "names", 0]`.

PeakingWidth.description: Peaking filter width specified either as a Q factor or a bandwidth in octaves.

PeqBand.description:
One band of an NPointPeq parametric equalizer.

The role of a band follows its position in the list: the first one is a low shelf,
the last one a high shelf, and the ones in between are peaking filters.

PipelineStep.description: One step in the processing pipeline: a mixer, filter chain, or processor.

PipelineStepFilter.description: Configuration for a filter pipeline step.

PipelineStepMixer.description: Configuration for a mixer pipeline step.

PipelineStepProcessor.description: Configuration for a processor pipeline step.

use_rf64.description:
Write an RF64 header so the file can grow past the 4 GB limit of plain
wav. Only applies when `wav_header` is true; ignored otherwise.

oneOf.description: Test-only paced playback device, see `src/dummy_backend`.

Sample format to convert each chunk to before discarding it.

Without one the audio is dropped as it arrives, which is cheaper. With one the
device converts the way a real one does on its way to the hardware, which is
where clipping happens and where `clipped_samples` comes from.

control_port.description: Port of the test control socket, see `src/dummy_backend/control.rs`.

ProcessingState.description:
The state of the processing, as reported by [`WsCommand::GetState`].

- `Running`: processing is running normally.
- `Paused`: processing is paused because the input signal is silent.
- `Inactive`: processing is off and devices are closed, waiting for a new configuration.
- `Starting`: opening devices and starting up processing with a new configuration.
- `Stalled`: the capture device is not providing data, so processing is stalled.

Processor.description: Processor type selector; each variant carries its own parameter struct.

RACEParameters.description: Parameters for the RACE (Recursive Ambiophonic Crosstalk Elimination) processor.

source.description: The file name, in the folder.

target.description: The new file name, in the same folder.

oneOf.description: Async polynomial resampler (low CPU, moderate quality).
Async sinc resampler (higher quality, configurable).
Synchronous FFT resampler for fixed integer ratios.

Slip resampler for compensating small clock drift at equal nominal rates.

Very low CPU, rate-adjustable, and adds no delay or high-frequency roll-off.
It only handles ratios close to 1.0, so it cannot convert between different
capture and playback sample rates.

file.description: The config file to run, a file name in config_dir.

oneOf.description:
How to follow the source. Null keeps the stored settings. Neither Adapt
nor Specific runs the file as it is.

SampleWidth.description: The width of the samples in a coefficient frame.

SamplerateCapability.description: The sample formats supported by a device at a specific sample rate.

formats.description: Names of the supported sample formats at this rate.

config.description: With the file paths as the GUI has them, relative to the configured folders.

ShelfSteepness.description: Shelf steepness specified either as a Q factor or a slope in dB/octave.

Shortcut.description: A control for one or more values in the config.

config_elements.description:
The values it controls. The control shows the first one, the others
follow it.

ShortcutSection.description: A group of shortcuts, with a heading.

oneOf.description: Sine wave at `freq` Hz and `level` dBFS.
Square wave at `freq` Hz and `level` dBFS.
White noise at `level` dBFS.

Signal.description: Signal type generated by the `SignalGenerator` capture device.

SourceFormat.description:
The format a source reported. Each field is given where the backend knows it, and is
`None` otherwise. Most backends know at least the rate, WASAPI only knows that something
changed.

The sample format is the backend's own name for it, as its configs and its capability
probing write it ("S24_3_LE" for ALSA, "S24" for CoreAudio). Backends differ in which
formats they have, so a name is what stays general across them.

format.description: Sample format, as the backend's configs name it.

frequencies.description: Center frequency of each output bin in Hz.

magnitudes.description: Per-bin peak magnitude in dBFS (0 dBFS = full-scale sine wave).

SpectrumSide.description:
Side selector for spectrum analysis commands.

Serialised as a lowercase string: `"playback"` or `"capture"`.

SpectrumSubscription.description:
Parameters for a streaming spectrum subscription ([`WsCommand::SubscribeSpectrum`]).

Same fields as [`SpectrumRequest`] plus an optional `max_rate` cap.

channel.description: Channel to analyze. `null` averages all channels; an integer selects a single channel (zero-based).

min_freq.description: Lower edge of the frequency range in Hz. Must be > 0.

max_freq.description: Upper edge of the frequency range in Hz. Must be > `min_freq`.

n_bins.description: Number of output bins. Must be ≥ 2.

max_rate.description:
Maximum push rate in Hz. Leave out or set `null` for the natural rate (one push per 50 %
overlap hop).

config_file_name.description: The file the config came from, null if it is not known.

adapted_to_samplerate.description:
The source rate CamillaDSP adapted the config to, when the source is
`adapted`.

oneOf.description: Present only when `state` is `Inactive`.

Status.description:
What `GET /api/status` answers. The processing state is not here, it comes
from `/api/events` as it changes. A value CamillaDSP declines to give, for
example with no config loaded, is null, and so is every value while it is
offline.

cdsp_online.description: Whether CamillaDSP answered the last time it was asked.

cdsp_version.description: CamillaDSP's version, null while it is offline.

capturerate.description:
The capture rate in Hz, rounded to the nearest standard rate. Null when
it is not within 4% of one.

oneOf.description:
The state of the built-in controller, null while offline or when
CamillaDSP has none. Its config files are given as names in config_dir,
when they are in it.

The settings of the built-in controller, null while offline, when
CamillaDSP has none, or when its statefile has no controller section.
A Specific template in config_dir is given as a file name.
Processing is still running; not yet stopped.
Processing completed normally (e.g. end of file input).
Capture device reported an error.
Playback device reported an error.
An unexpected internal error occurred.
Capture device format changed: `samplerate`, `channels` and `format`, null if unknown.

CaptureFormatChange.description: Capture device format changed: `samplerate`, `channels` and `format`, null if unknown.

oneOf.description: Playback device format changed, reported the same way as `CaptureFormatChange`.

PlaybackFormatChange.description: Playback device format changed, reported the same way as `CaptureFormatChange`.

TimeUnit.description: Unit for a time value (attack, release, envelope times).

files.description:
The files, each with its file name. A file of the same name is
replaced.

ValidationIssue.description: A problem with a config, one that CamillaDSP would refuse it for.

path.description:
Where in the config, as keys and list indices from the top. Empty for
the config as a whole.

VolumeFader.description: Which aux fader a Volume filter is linked to (faders 1–4; the main fader is always 0).

VolumeParameters.description: Parameters for the volume-ramp filter linked to a specific fader.

VuLevels.description:
Payload of a [`WsReply::VuLevelsEvent`] pushed by [`WsCommand::SubscribeVuLevels`].

All values are smoothed dB levels, per channel.

playback_rms.description: Smoothed RMS level per playback channel in dB.

playback_peak.description: Smoothed peak level per playback channel in dB.

capture_rms.description: Smoothed RMS level per capture channel in dB.

capture_peak.description: Smoothed peak level per capture channel in dB.

WavInfo.description: The header of a wav file.
